description: Applies a diff from diff_schema to the live data model, creating, altering and dropping collections and fields. Requires confirm: true. Destructive and not transactional: a mirror-mode diff drops whatever is missing from the snapshot, and a failure partway leaves the model half-migrated. The hash ties the diff to the model it was computed against and the call is refused when the model has moved since; force bypasses that check and can corrupt the model. Always run diff_schema first and keep a get_schema_snapshot backup.

diff.description: The { hash, diff } object returned by diff_schema

force.description: Bypass the hash and version safety check

name: apply_schema
